title: Qwen-Image-PE: Learning Visual Design for Text-to-Image Prompt Enhancement
title_zh: Qwen-Image-PE：为文生图提示增强学习视觉设计

paragraphs.en: Learning visual design is essential for prompt enhancement (PE) to turn underspecified user requests into coherent visual specifications for text-to-image (T2I) generation. Existing methods preserve user intent and improve overall visual appeal, with less explicit emphasis on fine-grained design dimensions. To address this gap, we introduce Qwen-Image-PE, which learns visual design through two-stage training. Supervised fine-tuning with Caption-Based Reverse Distillation (CRD) uses dense captions of well-designed images as design supervision. Reinforcement learning with Groupwise Design Reward (GDR) jointly compares all candidate images for the same request to refine lighting, composition, layout, and detail. On Qwen-Image-Bench with Qwen-Image-2.1, Qwen-Image-PE-397B improves over original requests by 7.81 points, while Qwen-Image-PE-9B outperforms all evaluated PE baselines. Further evaluations show gains in visual design, aesthetics, image quality, and human preference. We find that PE scales along three axes: training data, model size, and information density, with sufficient information density as a prerequisite for effective enhancement. Moreover, we demonstrate that Qwen-Image-PE generalizes to four additional T2I backbones, even surpassing native prompt enhancers on HunyuanImage-2.1 and FLUX 3 Image Klein. We release Qwen-Image-PE-9B at https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1-PE-T2I .
paragraphs.zh: 学习视觉设计对于提示词增强（PE）至关重要，它可以将不明确的用户请求转化为连贯的视觉规范，用于文本到图像（T2I）生成。 现有方法能够保留用户意图并提升整体视觉吸引力，但对细粒度设计维度的显式关注较少。 为填补这一空白，我们提出 Qwen-Image-PE，它通过两阶段训练学习视觉设计。 基于字幕的逆向蒸馏（CRD）监督微调以设计精良图像的稠密字幕作为设计监督信号。 基于分组设计奖励（GDR）的强化学习对同一请求的所有候选图像进行联合比较，以优化光照、构图、布局和细节。 在基于 Qwen-Image-2.1 的 Qwen-Image-Bench 上，Qwen-Image-PE-397B 相比原始请求提升了 7.81 分，而 Qwen-Image-PE-9B 则超越了所有被评测的 PE 基线。 进一步的评估表明，该方法在视觉设计、美学、图像质量和人类偏好方面均有所提升。 我们发现 PE 沿三个维度进行扩展：训练数据、模型规模和信息密度，其中足够的信息密度是实现有效增强的前提条件。 此外，我们证明 Qwen-Image-PE 能够泛化到另外四个 T2I 骨干模型，甚至在 HunyuanImage-2.1 和 FLUX 3 Image Klein 上超越其原生提示词增强器。 我们在 https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1-PE-T2I 发布了 Qwen-Image-PE-9B。

paragraphs.en: Modern text-to-image (T2I) models can follow increasingly detailed visual specifications, offering control over lighting, composition, layout, and fine-grained detail ( Wu et al., 2025b ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Black Forest Labs, 2026 ) . However, user requests are often brief and leave many of these choices unspecified ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Prompt enhancement (PE) bridges this gap by expanding user requests into detailed prompts. The visual choices introduced during enhancement shape how the requested content is presented, making visual design an important capability for prompt enhancers.

paragraphs.en: Existing prompt enhancement methods pursue semantic alignment by preserving and clarifying user intent ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Boogu Team, 2026 ; ERNIE Team, Baidu, 2026 ; Black Forest Labs, 2026 ) . Beyond semantic correctness, other approaches improve visual appeal through aesthetic or preference optimization ( Hao et al., 2022 ; Cao et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . However, these approaches primarily optimize overall visual appeal, with less explicit emphasis on individual design dimensions. We therefore study how PE can explicitly learn and refine fine-grained design dimensions, including lighting, composition, layout, and detail. The challenge is how to translate fine-grained visual design into effective supervision targets and optimization feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的提示词增强方法通过保留和澄清用户意图来追求语义对齐（Wang et al., 2025；Boogu Team, 2026；ERNIE Team, Baidu, 2026；Black Forest Labs, 2026）。 除了语义正确性之外，另一些方法通过美学或偏好优化来提升视觉吸引力（Hao et al., 2022；Cao et al., 2023；Tang et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2025）。 然而，这些方法主要优化整体视觉吸引力，较少明确地关注各个独立的设计维度。 因此，我们研究提示词增强如何显式地学习和改进细粒度的设计维度，包括光照、构图、布局和细节。 挑战在于如何将细粒度的视觉设计转化为有效的监督目标和优化反馈。

paragraphs.en: Our key insight is that: (1) Well-designed images demonstrate how design choices work together. Dense captions make these choices explicit, providing concrete supervision for PE to learn visual design. (2) Jointly comparing all candidate images for the same request provides a common basis for calibrating design scores. This groupwise comparison helps distinguish their relative quality, providing more informative feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的核心洞察是：(1) 经过精心设计的图像能够展示各种设计选择如何协同发挥作用。 密集描述使这些设计选择变得明确，为 PE 学习视觉设计提供了具体的监督信号。 (2) 对同一请求的所有候选图像进行联合比较，为校准设计分数提供了共同基础。 这种组内比较有助于区分它们的相对质量，从而提供更有信息量的反馈。

paragraphs.en: Guided by these insights, we introduce Qwen-Image-PE, which learns visual design through a two-stage training paradigm. First, supervised fine-tuning via Caption-Based Reverse Distillation (CRD) enables PE to imitate the design choices in well-designed images. We construct request–image pairs, select images for design quality and request consistency, and densely caption their visual content and design choices to obtain enhanced-prompt targets. These captions, together with synthesized design rationales, provide supervision for learning visual design. Second, reinforcement learning with Groupwise Design Reward (GDR) refines the enhancer through visual comparison. For each request, we generate images from a group of sampled enhanced prompts and arrange the images into a grid. A multimodal judge jointly scores the candidates under explicit design rubrics, conditioning each candidate’s scores on the full group. We combine these design scores with an alignment reward to optimize the enhancer while keeping the T2I backbone frozen.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些洞察，我们提出了 Qwen-Image-PE，它通过两阶段训练范式学习视觉设计。 首先，通过基于描述的反向蒸馏（CRD）进行监督微调，使 PE 能够模仿精心设计的图像中的设计选择。 我们构建请求—图像对，依据设计质量与请求一致性筛选图像，并对图像的视觉内容和设计选择进行密集描述，以获得增强提示目标。 这些描述与合成的设计依据共同为学习视觉设计提供监督信号。 其次，采用组级设计奖励（GDR）的强化学习通过视觉对比来优化增强器。 对于每个请求，我们从一组采样的增强提示生成图像，并将这些图像排成网格。 多模态评判模型在明确的设计评分标准下对候选结果进行联合打分，使每个候选的得分以整组图像为条件。 我们将这些设计得分与对齐奖励相结合来优化增强器，同时保持 T2I 主干网络冻结。

paragraphs.en: We further study the scaling properties and generalization behavior of PE, with four main findings. (1) PE scales with training data, model size, and information density. (2) Sufficient information density is a prerequisite for effective enhancement. (3) Both PE variants outperform original requests on four additional T2I backbones without access to their training captions. (4) On HunyuanImage-2.1 and FLUX 3 Image Klein, both variants outperform native prompt enhancers, suggesting that PE learns transferable visual design principles rather than generator-specific caption patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步研究了PE的缩放特性和泛化行为，得出四个主要发现。 （1）PE随训练数据、模型规模和信息密度而缩放。 （2）足够的信息密度是有效增强的前提条件。 （3）在无法访问其训练描述的情况下，两种PE变体在四个额外的T2I骨干模型上均优于原始请求。 （4）在HunyuanImage-2.1和FLUX 3 Image Klein上，两种变体均优于原生提示词增强器，这表明PE学习到的是可迁移的视觉设计原则，而非特定于生成器的描述模式。

paragraphs.en: User requests often leave visual design choices unspecified. Our objective is to learn a prompt enhancer that specifies these choices coherently while preserving the user’s explicit requirements. We focus on four fine-grained visual design dimensions. Lighting concerns physically coherent illumination: consistent light direction, shadows, highlights, and reflections, with natural color temperature, light falloff, and material sheen. Composition concerns subject placement and scale, focal hierarchy, balance, and depth layering. Layout concerns the alignment, spacing, whitespace, and typographic hierarchy of text, graphics, and content modules. Detail concerns the richness of material textures, local structures, environmental details, and meaningful informational content.
paragraphs.zh: 用户请求往往不会明确指定视觉设计选项。 我们的目标是学习一个提示词增强器，在保留用户显式要求的同时，连贯地指定这些选项。 我们关注四个细粒度的视觉设计维度。 光照关注物理上连贯的照明：一致的光线方向、阴影、高光与反射，以及自然的色温、光衰减和材质光泽。 构图关注主体位置与比例、焦点层级、平衡感以及景深层次。 排版关注文本、图形和内容模块的对齐、间距、留白以及字体层级。 细节关注材质纹理、局部结构、环境细节以及有意义的信息内容的丰富程度。

paragraphs.en: To ground design supervision in visual examples, we introduce Caption-Based Reverse Distillation (CRD) . Unlike forward-based prompt enhancement, which directly expands user requests into detailed prompts using a zero-shot or trained language model, CRD derives enhanced-prompt targets by densely captioning well-designed images. CRD constructs supervision in the image-to-text direction, reversing the direction of T2I generation. We then train the enhancer to predict these targets from user requests.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将设计监督建立在视觉示例之上，我们提出了基于描述的反向蒸馏（CRD）。 与基于前向的提示词增强（使用零样本或经过训练的语言模型直接将用户请求扩展为详细提示词）不同，CRD 通过对精心设计的图像进行密集描述来推导出增强提示词的目标。 CRD 在图像到文本的方向上构建监督，反转了文生图（T2I）生成的方向。 然后我们训练增强器从用户请求中预测这些目标。

paragraphs.en: (1) Transfer visual design through captions. Dense captions describe how visual content is organized and presented in an image. As shown in Figure 3 a, captions of well-designed images guide Qwen-Image-2.1 to regenerate key aspects of lighting, composition, layout, and detail. These examples suggest that dense captions encode visual design choices in a form that guides T2I generation. This motivates training the enhancer to predict such captions from user requests, thereby learning to imitate the design choices embodied in the source images. (2) Bridge the prompt–caption distribution gap. T2I generators are trained with caption-image pairs, while forward-based prompt enhancement can produce text that differs from their training caption distributions. We obtain enhanced prompts from Qwen-Image-PE-397B and Qwen-3.8-Max for the same 1,000 requests from Qwen-Image-Bench. Using Qwen-Image-2.1 text-encoder embeddings, we jointly visualize these prompts and 1,000 sampled T2I training captions with t-SNE ( Figure 3 b). Our prompt embeddings exhibit greater overlap with the training-caption embeddings than forward-enhanced prompt embeddings do. This suggests that CRD helps narrow the prompt–caption distribution gap by training the enhancer on dense image captions. Further quantitative results in Section 3.3.1 support this closer alignment.

paragraphs.en: To further refine visual design, we introduce Groupwise Design Reward (GDR) . Existing reward models, such as PickScore ( Kirstain et al., 2023 ) and HPSv3 ( Ma et al., 2025 ) , provide overall preference scores without explicit feedback on our four fine-grained design dimensions. Given the strong visual understanding and reasoning capabilities of MLLMs, we use an MLLM-based judge to assess these dimensions under explicit rubrics. While pointwise judging can assess individual images, it lacks shared visual references for distinguishing subtle design differences. Pairwise judging provides relative comparisons, but lacks a holistic view of the rollout group and incurs substantial evaluation overhead when all candidate pairs are compared. GDR combines full rollout-group context with efficient joint scoring. By evaluating all candidates together, it provides shared visual references while avoiding separate judge calls for individual images or candidate pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步优化视觉设计，我们引入了组内设计奖励（Groupwise Design Reward, GDR）。 现有的奖励模型，例如 PickScore（Kirstain et al., 2023）和 HPSv3（Ma et al., 2025），只提供整体偏好分数，而没有针对我们四个细粒度设计维度给出明确的反馈。 鉴于多模态大语言模型具备强大的视觉理解与推理能力，我们使用基于 MLLM 的评判器，在明确的评分细则下对这些维度进行评估。 虽然逐点评判可以评估单个图像，但它缺乏用于区分细微设计差异的共享视觉参照。 成对评判提供了相对比较，但缺乏对整个 rollout 组的整体视角，并且在比较所有候选对时会产生大量评估开销。 GDR 将完整的 rollout 组上下文与高效的联合打分相结合。 通过将所有候选放在一起评估，它既提供了共享的视觉参照，又避免了对单个图像或候选对分别调用评判器。

paragraphs.en: We assess overall generation performance, visual design, aesthetics, image quality, and human preference. The requests used for model evaluation do not overlap with those used for SFT or RL. The evaluation metrics described below are distinct from the training reward functions and are not used to optimize the enhancer. Qwen-Image-Bench ( Li et al., 2026 ) covers real-world creation scenarios using criteria developed with professional artists. Its hierarchy comprises five L1 dimensions (Quality, Aesthetics, Alignment, Real-world Fidelity, and Creative Generation) and finer L2 capabilities, including design-related dimensions like Lighting, Composition, Layout, and Detail. On images generated from Qwen-Image-Bench requests, UniPercept ( Cao et al., 2025 ) provides Image Aesthetics Assessment (IAA), Image Quality Assessment (IQA), and Image Structure and Texture Assessment (ISTA), measuring aesthetic appeal, visual quality, and structural and textural richness. We further assess aesthetics-related human preference using HPSv3 and PickScore ( Kirstain et al., 2023 ) on images generated from GenEval prompts ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ) , whose shorter length accommodates these metrics’ text-input limits. Finally, Good/Same/Bad (GSB) human evaluation assesses request fulfillment and visual appeal, recording whether annotators prefer our output, consider the outputs comparable, or prefer the baseline.

paragraphs.en: We examine the two training stages in Section 2 : whether supervised fine-tuning with Caption-Based Reverse Distillation helps the model learn visual design, and whether reinforcement learning with Groupwise Design Reward further refines these design choices.

paragraphs.en: We compare two strategies for supervised fine-tuning of the 397B enhancer, using the same multimodal language model (MLLM) to construct targets and identical training settings. Forward-Based Supervision uses the MLLM’s zero-shot enhanced prompts as targets, while Caption-Based Reverse Distillation uses it as a dense captioning model. We evaluate both models on Qwen-Image-Bench using Qwen-Image-2.1 as the T2I backbone. As shown in Table 3 (a), Caption-Based Reverse Distillation improves Overall from 59.86 to 61.52 (+1.66) and achieves higher scores across all five dimensions. The largest gains occur in Aesthetics (+3.00) and Creative Generation (+2.42). These results support caption-based supervision as an effective way to transfer visual design choices from well-designed images to the enhancer.

paragraphs.en: To measure the prompt–caption distribution gap, we compare enhanced prompts generated for Qwen-Image-Bench with an equal number of sampled real training captions. We measure token-level differences using unigram and bigram Jensen–Shannon (JS) divergence over corpus-wide token frequencies, distribution-level similarity using MAUVE ( Pillutla et al., 2021 ) , and embedding-level distance using Fréchet distance (FD). MAUVE and FD are computed from Qwen-Image-2.1 text-encoder representations. Table 4 shows that both PE variants achieve lower JS and FD and higher MAUVE than Qwen-3.8-Max. In particular, Qwen-Image-PE-397B reduces unigram/bigram JS from 0.229/0.539 to 0.105/0.329 and increases MAUVE from 0.032 to 0.414. Together with Figure 3 b, these results show that Qwen-Image-PE produces prompts closer to the training-caption distribution across all three levels, supporting the motivation for CRD.

paragraphs.en: Starting from the 397B model trained with Caption-Based Reverse Distillation, we compare reinforcement learning with Pointwise Design Reward and Groupwise Design Reward. Both use the same design rubric: Pointwise Design Reward evaluates each image independently, while Groupwise Design Reward jointly scores candidate images for the same request. We do not include exhaustive pairwise judging, as its quadratic number of MLLM calls per rollout group makes it impractical for online RL at our training scale. We evaluate both models on Qwen-Image-Bench using Qwen-Image-2.1 as the T2I backbone. As shown in Table 3 (b), Groupwise Design Reward achieves 62.17 Overall, exceeding Pointwise Design Reward by 0.81 points and the initialization by 0.65 points. It improves four of the five dimensions over pointwise scoring, with the largest gain in Aesthetics (+1.70). These results support groupwise visual comparison as effective feedback for refining visual design.

paragraphs.en: We sample nested subsets of 12.5K, 25K, 50K, and 100K examples from our training data, such that each larger subset contains all examples in the smaller subsets. Each doubling improves performance, but the incremental gains decrease from 0.81 to 0.63 and then 0.30 points. These results show that additional training data consistently benefits the enhancer, although the smaller gain from 50K to 100K indicates diminishing returns over the evaluated range.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从训练数据中采样嵌套的子集，规模分别为 12.5K、25K、50K 和 100K 个样本，使得每个较大的子集都包含较小子集中的全部样本。 我们在每个子集上训练一个 Qwen3.5-9B PE 模型，保留原有的 caption 监督并遵循相同的 SFT 配方。 如图 7a 所示，随着训练集规模扩大，Overall 从 55.87 分别提升至 56.68、57.31 和 57.61，总增益为 1.74 分。 每次翻倍都能提升性能，但增量收益从 0.81 分降至 0.63 分，再降至 0.30 分。 这些结果表明，增加训练数据能持续地使增强器受益，尽管从 50K 到 100K 的增益较小，表明在所评估的范围内收益递减。

paragraphs.en: We fix the PE model at Qwen3.5-9B and the training-data size at 50K examples, providing captions at four information-density levels (L1–L4) as supervision. We measure the information content of each trained model’s sampled enhanced prompts using Grounded Perplexity Gain (GPG) ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . GPG measures how much observing a paired image increases the text’s likelihood under a frozen vision-language model. For each model’s outputs on Qwen-Image-Bench, we use frozen Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct to sum token log-likelihood gains from observing the corresponding generated images and average over prompts. paragraphs.zh: 我们将PE模型固定为Qwen3.5-9B，将训练数据规模固定为5万条样本，并提供四个信息密度级别（L1–L4）的描述作为监督。 我们使用Grounded Perplexity Gain（GPG）（Chen et al., 2026）来衡量每个训练模型采样得到的增强提示的信息量。 GPG衡量的是在一个冻结的视觉-语言模型下，观察配对图像能使文本似然提升多少。 对于每个模型在Qwen-Image-Bench上的输出，我们使用冻结的Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct对观察相应生成图像所带来的token对数似然增益求和，并在各提示上取平均。 L1–L4的平均总GPG分别为14.42、41.16、87.25和170.36。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image (T2I) generation aims to synthesize images that correspond to textual descriptions. Earlier work advanced image fidelity and text–image alignment, enabling models to generate visually plausible subjects and scenes from text ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Podell et al., 2023 ) . More recent systems support increasingly precise control over visual presentation, allowing detailed prompts to guide lighting, composition, layout, and fine-grained detail ( Wu et al., 2025a ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; ByteDance Seed, 2026 ; Black Forest Labs, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2026b ; Google DeepMind, 2026 ) . Although these models support detailed visual control, user requests often leave design choices unspecified. Our work studies how prompt enhancement can specify and coordinate these choices through detailed prompts to form coherent visual designs.
paragraphs.zh: 文生图（T2I）生成旨在合成与文本描述相符的图像。 早期工作提升了图像保真度和文本—图像对齐能力，使模型能够根据文本生成视觉上可信的主体和场景（ Rombach et al., 2022 ; Podell et al., 2023 ）。 更近期的系统支持对视觉呈现越来越精确的控制，允许详细的提示词来指导光照、构图、布局和细粒度细节（ Wu et al., 2025a ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; ByteDance Seed, 2026 ; Black Forest Labs, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2026b ; Google DeepMind, 2026 ）。 尽管这些模型支持精细的视觉控制，但用户的请求往往不会明确指定设计选择。 我们的工作研究提示词增强如何通过详细的提示词来明确并协调这些选择，从而形成连贯的视觉设计。

paragraphs.en: Prompt enhancement (PE) transforms user requests into detailed prompts while preserving user intent. A central objective is semantic alignment, which involves clarifying user intent and expanding generation conditions while preserving explicit content and spatial constraints ( Boogu Team, 2026 ; Black Forest Labs, 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . HunyuanImage-2.1-PE further employs chain-of-thought reasoning to produce detailed prompts that faithfully express user requirements ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . Beyond semantic correctness, existing approaches optimize visual appeal through aesthetic and preference rewards ( Hao et al., 2022 ; Cao et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . ERNIE-Image-PE also enriches requests with structured descriptions of layout, composition, textual content, and scene structure ( ERNIE Team, Baidu, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 提示词增强（PE）在保留用户意图的同时，将用户请求转化为详细提示词。 一个核心目标是语义对齐，即在保留显式内容和空间约束的前提下，澄清用户意图并扩展生成条件（ Boogu Team, 2026 ; Black Forest Labs, 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ）。 HunyuanImage-2.1-PE 进一步采用思维链推理来生成忠实表达用户需求的详细提示词（ Wang et al., 2025 ）。 除语义正确性之外，现有方法还通过美学和偏好奖励来优化视觉吸引力（ Hao et al., 2022 ; Cao et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ）。 ERNIE-Image-PE 还通过关于布局、构图、文本内容和场景结构的结构化描述来丰富请求（ ERNIE Team, Baidu, 2026 ）。

paragraphs.en: Our work optimizes fine-grained visual design dimensions, including lighting, composition, layout, and detail. Supervised fine-tuning with Caption-Based Reverse Distillation trains the enhancer to imitate design choices captured in dense captions of well-designed images, while reinforcement learning with Groupwise Design Reward refines these choices through groupwise visual comparison. Concurrent work WanPE ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) also constructs supervision from captions for text-to-video prompt enhancement. It targets coherent cinematic planning across shots and over time, whereas our work focuses on fine-grained visual design within individual images. In addition, we study the scaling properties of PE and its generalization behavior across T2I backbones.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作优化细粒度的视觉设计维度，包括光照、构图、布局和细节。 基于「标注逆向蒸馏」的监督微调训练增强器，使其模仿从精心设计图像的稠密标注中捕获的设计选择，而基于「组级设计奖励」的强化学习则通过组级视觉比较来精炼这些选择。 同期工作 WanPE（Zhu et al., 2026）也从标注中构建监督信号，用于文本到视频的提示增强。 它旨在实现跨镜头和跨时间的一致性电影级规划，而我们的工作专注于单张图像内的细粒度视觉设计。 此外，我们还研究了提示增强的扩展特性及其在不同文本到图像骨干网络上的泛化行为。

paragraphs.en: We present Qwen-Image-PE, which learns fine-grained visual design through imitation and comparative refinement. Supervised fine-tuning via Caption-Based Reverse Distillation provides concrete design supervision, while reinforcement learning with Groupwise Design Reward refines design choices through groupwise visual comparison. Experiments show improvements in overall generation performance, visual design, and human preference. Our scaling experiments suggest that sufficient information density is a prerequisite for effective enhancement. Both PE variants also improve Overall over original requests on four additional T2I backbones without access to their training captions, supporting the transfer of learned visual design principles. We hope this work encourages future research to make visual design a central objective of prompt enhancement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Qwen-Image-PE，它通过模仿与对比式精炼来学习细粒度的视觉设计。 基于字幕的逆向蒸馏提供的监督微调提供了具体的设计监督，而基于组内设计奖励的强化学习则通过组内视觉比较来精炼设计选择。 实验表明，该方法在整体生成性能、视觉设计和人类偏好方面均有提升。 我们的扩展实验表明，充足的信息密度是实现有效增强的前提。 两种 PE 变体在四个额外的文生图骨干模型上也无需访问其训练字幕即可提升相对于原始请求的 Overall 表现，这支持了所学视觉设计原则的可迁移性。 我们希望这项工作能鼓励未来研究将视觉设计作为提示增强的核心目标。
